_comment: Moon science targets for the Moon 3 level (spec: Moon orbit, Targets). Each target has a location from the IAU Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature (or LROC's published Apollo 11 position), a one-line lesson, a science weight (game estimate; the four sum to 1), what its picture needs, and one LROC Narrow Angle Camera frame from the PDS archive, checked against its catalogue page on Oct 27, 2026. The game uses PDS products because LROC's terms put them in the public domain, while the LROC website's own images are copyrighted. Copies are made by scripts/fetch-targets.py into public/targets/ and public/moon/.
